verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's own Admin API documents deleting projects, environments, flags, segments and users, and self-hosting is described as giving full control over your data, so deletion control and data residency are covered in a thin way. Nothing in the evidence documents retention controls such as configurable retention periods, automatic purging, or privacy-specific deletion of identity data. missing for 10: configurable data-retention policies/periods, documented identity/PII deletion workflow (e.g. GDPR erasure), retention controls for audit logs and experimentation event data, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
